# Publishing: Threads

See [the Threads guide](../../publishing/threads.md) for how to get these values.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `publish.threads.api-base-url`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_THREADS_API_BASE_URL`<br>`--publish-threads-api-base-url` | string | `https://graph.threads.net/v1.0` | Threads API base URL |
| `publish.threads.caption`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_THREADS_CAPTION`<br>`--publish-threads-caption` | string | — | Threads specific post text |
| `publish.threads.enabled`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_THREADS_ENABLED`<br>`--publish-threads-enabled` | bool | — | publish to Threads |
| `publish.threads.fit`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_THREADS_FIT`<br>`--publish-threads-fit` | string | `none` | how the render is made to match threads's frame: none, cover, contain or stretch; anything but none needs width and height |
| `publish.threads.fit-background`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_THREADS_FIT_BACKGROUND`<br>`--publish-threads-fit-background` | string | `#ffffff` | hex colour behind a contain letterbox for threads, and what transparency is flattened onto |
| `publish.threads.height`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_THREADS_HEIGHT`<br>`--publish-threads-height` | int | — | render height for threads; 0 inherits render.height |
| `publish.threads.lead-video`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_THREADS_LEAD_VIDEO`<br>`--publish-threads-lead-video` | string, path | — | not available: a threads post is pictures or a video and never both, so a value here is refused rather than ignored |
| `publish.threads.max-attachments`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_THREADS_MAX_ATTACHMENTS`<br>`--publish-threads-max-attachments` | int | — | post at most this many pages to threads at once; 0 uses the platform's own limit, which is also the ceiling |
| `publish.threads.music-file`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_THREADS_MUSIC_FILE`<br>`--publish-threads-music-file` | string, path | — | not available: threads has no API for attaching an audio file, so a value here is refused rather than ignored |
| `publish.threads.overlay`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_THREADS_OVERLAY`<br>`--publish-threads-overlay` | list, path | — | template overlays applied for threads only, after the global ones |
| `publish.threads.poll-interval`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_THREADS_POLL_INTERVAL`<br>`--publish-threads-poll-interval` | duration | `2s` | how often the media container status is polled |
| `publish.threads.poll-timeout`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_THREADS_POLL_TIMEOUT`<br>`--publish-threads-poll-timeout` | duration | `2m` | how long to wait for the media container to be ready |
| `publish.threads.token`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_THREADS_TOKEN`<br>`--publish-threads-token` | string | — | Threads access token, with the threads_basic and threads_content_publish scopes; an Instagram token is not one **Secret**: redacted by `crier config`. |
| `publish.threads.user-id`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_THREADS_USER_ID`<br>`--publish-threads-user-id` | string | — | Threads account user id, as /me reports it |
| `publish.threads.width`<br>`CRIER_PUBLISH_THREADS_WIDTH`<br>`--publish-threads-width` | int | — | render width for threads; 0 inherits render.width |

A sample carrying every key with its default is at
[`crier.example.yaml`](../../../crier.example.yaml).
